cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The model cloud produced one drop. Let's build the welcome tray.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That doesn't prove the full rain machine works.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. It proves the tray has a purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put the small success where we can still see it.

mechanism: A supervises a concrete preparation that sustains another person's impossible hope while withholding a demonstrable reason for likely failure.
confusable: Celebrating a setback differs from D159: A must protect someone else's hope through practical evidence and selective concealment.
comparison: A miniature success and public demonstration can differ from a family waiting for a time traveler.
seedUse: Use one real drop as limited evidence, but replace welcome-tray vagueness and establish what A hides.
